feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: GPT-6.2 Astra assists a field-exclusion proof for a weighted Lucas sum
entry.summary: The preprint reports that a weighted reciprocal sum of even-indexed Lucas numbers lies outside the quadratic field generated by the square root of five. It extends the irrationality claim across positive integer strides. (Discovery - twinheterodox; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: AI assists a minimax result for one-bit graph fingerprints
entry.summary: The preprint reports an optimal worst-case distinguishing probability of 8/27 for a specified family of randomized graph fingerprints with three vertex roles and symmetric Boolean tables. It also classifies optimal tables. (Discovery - Viktor Diakin; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: AI assists a proof of Ehrhart positivity for integral polypositroids
entry.summary: Luis Ferroni reports a proof that every coefficient of the Ehrhart polynomial of an integral polypositroid is positive. (Discovery - Luis Ferroni; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: GPT-6.1 Astra assists a gradient rank theorem for metric measure spaces
entry.summary: Fabrice Baudoin develops a finite-rank gradient framework and proves that the pointwise gradient rank is strictly below p almost everywhere under the hypotheses of his rank theorem. The result assumes a small-scale doubling measure, a Poincaré inequality and cutoffs with a matching energy scale… (Discovery - Fabrice Baudoin; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: Apache Kudu fixes an out-of-bounds read in deprecated range predicates
entry.summary: The CNA documented an out-of-bounds read affecting deprecated range predicates. (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: XGBoost guides the selection of two experimentally tested spinel catalysts
entry.summary: The authors report that two structural descriptors jointly predict polysulfide conversion and that they experimentally tested two model-nominated spinel oxide catalysts. The compositions differ from the catalyst highlighted in their earlier single-descriptor work. (Discovery - Nanyang Technological University; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Physics-informed deep learning guides a synthesized titanium halide electrolyte
entry.summary: The authors synthesize Li₄TiBr₄Cl₄ and report room-temperature ionic conductivity of 1.14 mS/cm. A laboratory cell retained 90.6% capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. (Discovery - Central South University; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: OpenAI models help reduce circuit area in the Jalapeño inference chip
entry.summary: OpenAI estimates that AI-proposed changes cut standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit. OpenAI reports that the optimizations were verified during silicon bring-up. The August announcement reported chip-level performance, while this November account provides… (Discovery - OpenAI; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Machine learning guides a nickel–cobalt catalyst for lithium–oxygen batteries
entry.summary: The authors selected a nickel–cobalt dual-atom catalyst and report 2,075 cycles in a laboratory lithium–oxygen battery operating along a four-electron lithium hydroxide pathway. (Discovery - Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen); City University of Hong Kong; Shenzhen University; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: AI assists a proof of a uniform gap for the square-lattice AKLT model
entry.summary: The preprint reports a uniform lower bound for the spectral gap on sufficiently large square-lattice tori and uniqueness results for the ground state. (Discovery - P. M. Aronow; Patrick Lopatto; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: GnuTLS fixes a denial-of-service issue in RSA-PSK authentication
entry.summary: GnuTLS documented a denial-of-service risk under memory pressure in the affected versions. (Vulnerability - AISLE Research Team; GnuTLS Project; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: GnuTLS fixes a denial-of-service issue in certificate handling
entry.summary: GnuTLS documented a denial-of-service risk under memory pressure in the affected versions. (Vulnerability - AISLE Research Team; GnuTLS Project; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Machine learning selects a plasma protein panel evaluated for Parkinson’s disease
entry.summary: A two-stage study of 391 participants identified a five-protein plasma panel. The authors tested selected proteins in a separate cohort that included Parkinson’s disease, multiple system atrophy and healthy controls. (Discovery - First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University; Peking University First Hospital; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Machine learning selects a protein panel that improves myocardial infarction risk prediction
entry.summary: A 23-protein panel raised the C-statistic from 0.710 to 0.733 when added to conventional risk factors in 37,187 UK Biobank participants, including 630 myocardial infarction cases. (Discovery - China Kadoorie Biobank; University of Oxford; UK Biobank; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Apache log4net fixes an issue that could lose a database log event
entry.summary: The Apache advisory describes loss of a log event when the database cannot store its text. (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Apache log4net fixes an integrity issue affecting XML log events
entry.summary: The Apache advisory describes an encoding-related risk to the integrity of XML log output. (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Apache log4net fixes an issue that could hide log events
entry.summary: The Apache advisory describes a case where later log events can be hidden in XML output. (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Oracle discloses a Java vulnerability reported by Calif researchers
entry.summary: Oracle published an advisory for a vulnerability affecting specified Java SE and GraalVM versions. (Vulnerability - Calif; Oracle; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Gemini assists a proof of stability for three-dimensional passive quantum memory
entry.summary: Patrick Hayden reports a three-dimensional welded-code construction and stability results in separate thermal and zero-temperature perturbative regimes. (Discovery - Google DeepMind; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps construct a compact non-Kähler Ricci soliton
entry.summary: The authors construct a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton on a simply connected eight-dimensional flag manifold and show that its metric is nowhere locally Kähler. (Discovery - Timothy Buttsworth; Henry Wood; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: AI assists a computer-aided proof of the Reinhardt conjecture
entry.summary: Fei Xue reports that the smoothed regular octagon minimizes optimal lattice-packing density among centrally symmetric convex disks in the plane. (Discovery - Fei Xue; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Axiom Prover formalization identifies a missing case in a published group classification
entry.summary: Axiom reports that formalizing a 2019 theorem about automorphism groups of curves exposed an omission in its printed list. The group SL(2,3) occurs for a specific curve and was already present in the original authors’ computation. (Discovery - Axiom; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Machine-learning screening guides a measured reversal of the anomalous Nernst signal
entry.summary: A materials-screening study led the authors to test Co₂TiGe single crystals. The preprint reports a reversal of the anomalous Nernst signal near 225 K. (Discovery - Haofu Wen and coauthors; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra assists work on the Chabauty–Kim dimension inequality
entry.summary: Sa’ar Zehavi reports a proof of Kim’s conjectural dimension inequality for a specified class of curves, using noncommutative Iwasawa theory. (Discovery - Max Planck Institute for Mathematics; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Structure-based virtual screening with AlphaFold identifies CLIP1-LTK inhibitors.
entry.summary: The structure-guided pipeline and analog search yielded an inhibitor tested biochemically, in cells and in xenografts. Evidence is preclinical; AI did not perform every selection step. (Discovery - Zhejiang University; First Affiliated Hospital Zhejiang University; Soochow University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Machine learning-guided discovery and preliminary biological evaluation of novel GSK-3β inhibitory scaffolds with anti-inflammatory potential.
entry.summary: RF03 and RF05 show moderate micromolar inhibition; cellular effects do not prove target specificity. Journal record retained once; matching preprint excluded separately. (Discovery - Southwest University; Army Medical University; Daping Hospital; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: openemr security disclosure (CVE-2026-126462)
entry.summary: The CVE Program lists CVE-2026-126462 as a public security disclosure affecting openemr. AISLE attributes discovery to its AI engine. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Knowledge Graph-Based Hypothesis Generation and Experimental Validation in Yeast
entry.summary: The versioned primary abstract reports new gene-chemical interaction hypotheses in nonpathogenic laboratory yeast, supported by automated growth assays after multiple-testing correction. Interaction support does not establish full mechanism. (Discovery - Chalmers University of Technology; University of Gothenburg; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: Machine Learning–Driven Inverse Design of Gradient Porous Elastomers for High-Performance Flexible Pressure Sensors
entry.summary: A fabricated gradient-porous sensor received response, range and cycling tests; evidence is version-1 preprint abstract only, without a journal-equivalence claim. (Discovery - Beijing Institute of Technology; Sun Yat-sen University; Yangtze University; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Machine learning-guided TsOH/glycerol fractionation of sugarcane bagasse for fermentable sugar production: Experimental validation and molecular insights.
entry.summary: Random-forest predictions selected bagasse fractionation and hydrolysis conditions; separate experiments confirmed cellulose retention and sugar-yield outcomes. Biomass processing only, without organism engineering. (Discovery - Jiangnan University; Universidade de São Paulo; University of Belgrade; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: Accelerated formulation screening of multi-component bioinks via a deep learning-integrated high-throughput gradient printing platform.
entry.summary: Learned image analysis supported bioink selection, with cell assays and improved early regeneration in a rat bone-defect model. (Discovery - Sun Yat-sen University; Zhengzhou University; announced 2026-11-06)

entry.title: AI-assisted discovery of antifibrotic compounds
entry.summary: The preprint reports preclinical tests of model-selected compounds, including an animal-model result. It does not establish human efficacy. (Discovery - Westlake University; Tsinghua University; announced 2026-11-04)

entry.title: Large-Scale Prospective Virtual Screening Using a Co-Folding-Rescoring Workflow for NPM1-TYK2 Inhibitor Discovery.
entry.summary: Prospective screening yielded an experimentally active TYK2 hit and a more potent analog. (Discovery - Zhejiang University; Chinese University of Hong Kong; announced 2026-11-03)

entry.title: FFmpeg security disclosure (CVE-2026-120246)
entry.summary: The CVE Program lists CVE-2026-120246 as a public security disclosure affecting FFmpeg. AISLE attributes discovery to its AI engine. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-01)

entry.title: FFmpeg security disclosure (CVE-2026-120243)
entry.summary: The CVE Program lists CVE-2026-120243 as a public security disclosure affecting FFmpeg. AISLE attributes discovery to its AI engine. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-01)

entry.title: Sustainable biobased packaging via integrated robotics/machine learning workflow for improved postharvest preservation.
entry.summary: Manufactured films had measured barrier and stability properties and extended produce shelf life. Scope is benign materials and food preservation; no pathogen work is evaluated. (Discovery - University of Maryland, College Park; Agricultural Research Service; Beltsville Agricultural Research Center; announced 2026-10-28)

entry.title: Autonomous Discovery of Multi-Material Metamaterials With Programmable Multimodal Thermal Responses via Reinforcement Learning.
entry.summary: Generated multi-material architectures with new thermal responses were fabricated and experimentally validated. (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; Ningbo Institute of Industrial Technology; Tohoku University; announced 2026-10-28)

entry.title: AI-guided discovery and expansion of the human bile acid landscape.
entry.summary: Human-sample mass spectrometry supports new bile-acid detections; cellular and cardiomyocyte assays support one candidate activity. Structural and cohort details remain bounded by abstract access. (Discovery - University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital; announced 2026-10-27)

entry.title: golang.org/x/net/html security disclosure (CVE-2026-78661)
entry.summary: The CVE Program lists CVE-2026-78661 as a public security disclosure affecting golang.org/x/net/html. AISLE attributes discovery to its AI engine. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-10-27)

entry.title: Accelerated discovery and optimization of a potent and selective MMP12 inhibitor with the machine learning platform CAMOLE-1
entry.summary: Iterative therapeutic MMP12 inhibitor design was supported by biochemical testing and experimental complex structures. (Discovery - Calico Life Sciences; announced 2026-10-26)
